summary: A free monthly dance night presented by the venue Foothills Watershed (Old Fort, NC, near Asheville) together with 'Slow Down Sound w/ Old School Dance Hall', featuring a 30-minute line dancing/two-step lesson followed by open dancing to a live band, plus food trucks and local beer. It reads as a recurring venue event night rather than a bounded community: no membership language, sign-up form, Facebook group for attendees, or named regulars appears anywhere.

evidence.note: Listings describe only the lesson + open dance format with live band Old School Dance Hall; location field is blank in every listing and there is no mention of members, regulars, or a group identity.

Venue's own event page states it is 'Presented by Foothills Watershed + Slow Down Sound w/ Old School Dance Hall' and explicitly has no mention of regular attendees, members, or a returning community; framed as an accessible public gathering.
Same event series also appears on a McDowell County tourism events listing, confirming it is a touring/recurring venue night rather than a page for a standalone community.
Search for 'Old School Dance Hall' as a band/organizer in Asheville turned up no dedicated Facebook, Instagram, or website presence for the band itself, only third-party venue event pages.
A Facebook post titled 'HONKY TONK DANCE HALL RETURNS!' is a venue announcement of the event's return after a hiatus, not a member-facing group page.
